title: Biggest Single Number
goal: Return the largest number that appears exactly once, or null when none exists.
strategy: Count complete value groups before selecting a maximum. A large duplicated value is ineligible, and an empty set of singletons must still produce one null result row.

phasePurposes.start: Return the largest number that appears exactly once, or null when none exists.

phasePurposes.done: Return the largest number that appears exactly once, or null when none exists.

edgeCases: Every value repeated returns one null row
Negative singletons still have a numeric maximum
An empty table still returns null
